# .count()  : It is used to count the no. of rows generated by a specific querey.
# .values_count()  : It is used to count the no. of unique rows in a series or dataframe.

# To find the name start with specific letter or not (eg. G) : df[df[column].str.startswith("G")]
                                                        OR
                                                             : df[df[column].str[0]=="G"]
